Stylish Man The Chef containing not only the bomb of laughter, but the audience can also gain practical cooking knowledge throughout the program.

programme.title: Fly Me to the Moon
programme.desc: New Hong Kong immigrants Yuan and her sister face identity crises, poverty, and their father's drug addiction. Initially, the sisters attempt to appease him, but as they enter adolescence, they ultimately rebel and escape. Even as they separate from their father, Yuan finds his traits mirrored in her loved ones.

programme.title: Shock Wave
programme.desc: Bomb specialist Cheung Choi San sets out to capture a wanted criminal called Blast. However, will he be able to do it in time before Blast kills hundreds of citizens inside Hong Kong's busiest Cross Harbour Tunnel and destroys everything in his quest for revenge?

programme.title: My Wife is a Gambling Maestro
programme.desc: Natalie Yao Meng stars as the gambling queen, Ying Ying, who is a contender for the Asian God of Gamblers competition. But before the competition she is betrayed by her fiancé and left for dead. Rescued by a young man called Gerrard, who suffering from amnesia, Ying Ying, must recover in time to compete in the big event!

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng recalls his violent childhood memories when he finds an anonymous suicide note in the classroom. While he has to prevent the tragedy involving a suicidal student from happening, he also has to face a series of family problems with his wife wanting to divorce him and his father's serious illness.

programme.title: The Monkey King
programme.desc: After Goddess Nuwa sacrifices herself to save the mortal world, Monkey King comes into being from one of her crystals. Powerful and uncontrollable, Monkey King challenges the Jade Emperor and causes an uproar in heaven, unwittingly creating an opportunity for the wicked Buffalo Demon King to wage war in heaven.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: You Ji Ren is a blind man who works at a factory on an outlying island. When the factory is cut off from the outside world by a hurricane one day, a monster appears and turns whoever sees it into black shadows. As You cannot see the monster, he is able to help his other co-workers escape safely and fight to kill the monster.

programme.title: The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: A crooked watch dealer assembles a daring crew - a thief, an explosive expert, a lock breaker and a watch connoisseur - to steal three luxury watches in Tokyo. Their mission takes an unexpected turn when they discover the legendary 'Moonwatch.' Pursued by the yakuza, the team must unite to navigate the chaos and pull off their high-stakes heist.

programme.title: Our Crazy Adventures
programme.desc: Before graduation, five high school friends - Jia Yi, Kopi, Uncle, Wawa and Ah Di - decide to do something unforgettable together. Chasing dreams, friendship and youthful passion, they take on a seemingly impossible challenge, winning a crucial basketball game that could change their lives and shape their future forever.

programme.title: Lelio PoPo
programme.desc: Former radio DJs KK and Ah Luke were once hugely popular, but their bad attitudes and eccentric behaviour got them fired. Desperate for a comeback, they audition for a new radio station searching for elderly female hosts. Disguising themselves as old ladies, the pair unexpectedly land the job and spark a series of hilarious misadventures.

programme.title: Relentless Fury
programme.desc: Captain Lin Lang and his elite mercenary team are tasked with escorting a mysterious woman safely home. Bearing the highest bounty in dark web history, she draws assassins from across the globe. Among them is the notorious fugitive Ray. Now, Lin and his team must survive a deadly fight to complete their mission.

programme.title: Last Song For You
programme.desc: That summer, young Xia and Su bonded over their love of music, wondering how far this love could take them. Years later, musician Su unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journey—her parting gift to reignite his life.

programme.title: High Forces
programme.desc: On its maiden flight, an A380 airliner is hijacked by armed gunmen. Among the passengers is international security expert Gao Hao Jun, whose daughter has been taken hostage, putting her life in grave danger. Determined to save her, Gao confronts the hijackers head-on. Can he rescue all the passengers and thwart the crisis?

programme.title: Welcome to My Side
programme.desc: After a painful breakup and a strange accident, Chen Xiao Zhou is haunted by flocks of quacking rubber ducks that only he can see. His bizarre curse disappears whenever he is with the cheerful Feng Jia Nan. As they grow closer, an absurd yet heartwarming romance blossoms, changing both their lives in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Way We Talk, The
programme.desc: This is a soul-searching story about three youths: Wolf, Sophie and Alan, each living with a different form of deafness. Through sign language, they cultivate a profound friendship and offer each other unwavering support. United by love and friendship, the trio embarks on a journey of self-discovery and resilience.

programme.title: Someday Or One Day
programme.desc: The movie is a spin-off from the TV series of the same name. While Huang Yu Xuan mourns the death of her boyfriend, she receives a mysterious cassette player that allows her to travel back in time. She meets her boyfriend then again, but will she be able to change his destiny?

programme.title: Bursting Point
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Bang sends Officer Ming undercover to a drug cartel to displace drug lord Yang. A failed raid triggers Yang's rage for revenge. Meanwhile, drug maker Ying Xiu is forced to cooperate with the police and sets a trap for Yang. The battle between the police and the drug cartel has just begun!

programme.title: Hong Kong Family
programme.desc: Eight years ago, the family in a Hakka-walled village was torn apart during a combative winter solstice dinner. Eight years later, their cousin returns home from England and seeks to reunite the family for another winter solstice dinner. While things seem to be falling apart, this dinner may well be an opportunity to mend relations.

programme.title: YOLO
programme.desc: Feeling lost and aimless, Le Ying chooses to withdraw from society after a short working experience. After a series of unexpected events one day, she decides to embrace life anew. She sees a chance for a fresh start when she meets a boxing coach, yet the challenges ahead far exceed her expectations, marking a vibrant start to her journey.

programme.title: Schemes in Antiques
programme.desc: Despite his family's expertise in ancient Chinese relics, Xu Yuan becomes an electronics shop owner to distance himself from his disgraced family. However, when an antique is to be returned to China, Xu Yuan uncovers an ancient mystery and soon embarks on a journey that can finally restore his family's reputation but may also cost him his life.

programme.title: Mama's Affair
programme.desc: Former talent manager Mei Fung stays home to take care of her husband and son after retirement. She decides to re-enter the entertainment business to find her value in life, and successfully transforms a local restaurant delivery boy, Fong Ching, into a young pop idol. This makes her teenage son, Jonathan, intensely jealous of Fong Ching.

programme.title: Triad
programme.desc: This is a story about the Hong Kong Triads. Ting (William Chan). Cheung (Derek Tsang) and Dong (Edward Chui) are childhood friends who join a Triad together. After joining however, they discover that fame and fortune will ultimately break them apart as only one of them can become the leader of the gang.

programme.title: Back to the Past
programme.desc: After helping Ying Zheng unite China, Hong Siu Lung lives in seclusion for 20 years. However, peace is shattered when a group of time travellers returns with modern weapons to seize the Qin throne. Forced to reunite after decades apart, Hong Siu Lung and Ying Zheng must fight to defend the Qin dynasty and protect the fate of history itself.

programme.title: Reunion Dinner
programme.desc: Chao Yang and Zi Hong are soon to wed but both have not met the other's parents. When a client requests for a livestream of their reunion dinner to promote his products, it set the stage for their parents' first meeting. Estranged from his mother, Yang decides to rent a family for the dinner which results in a series of mishaps and hilarity.

programme.title: Life Must Go On
programme.desc: When the “midnight gymnasium” programme for wayward teenage girls is at funding risk, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match and save it. With an ex-star athlete John as the coach, the girls realize they must face their problems and overcome their challenges instead of dodging them. Can they finally win the match?

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: Peg O' My Heart
programme.desc: Psychiatrist Dr. Man begins treating night-shift taxi driver Choi, who is afraid to sleep and can no longer distinguish dreams from reality. During therapy, Dr. Man becomes haunted by his own disturbing and perplexing dreams. Are these night terrors the result of repressed memories, or the price of uncovering the ghosts hidden in Choi's past?

programme.title: Under Current
programme.desc: A charity gala turns deadly when the finance director is found dead and HK$200 million in donations vanish. Lawyer Ma Ying Fung joins an inspector to uncover a web of money laundering and murder.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 1
programme.desc: Wu Dang Sect's Zhang Chui Shan's son, Zhang Wu Ji, finds himself accidentally embroiled in the fight for the Dragon Sabre. When he unwittingly learns the powerful martial arts skills from the Jiuyin scriptures, Wu Ji proceeds to help the Six Major sects fight against the corrupt government.

programme.title: Smashing Frank
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves "Frank," their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game.

programme.title: The Sleep Curse
programme.desc: During the Japanese occupation of Hong Kong, a young translator colluded with the enemy and was cursed by a murdered comfort woman. Forty five years later, the translator's son who is a professor specializing in sleeping disorder does not believe in the sleep curse on his father and tries to dispel it with a horrifying sleep experiment.

programme.title: Beyond The Sin
programme.desc: The only daughter of Inspector Yan is brutally murdered, and her classmate Wen is arrested. Believing the case closed, Yan leaves the police force. However, when more girls are killed after Wen's imprisonment, Yan begins to suspect the real killer is still at large and vows to find the truth.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony
programme.desc: After falling victim to a romance scam and being left with massive debt, Lin Qinglang teams up with con artist Ouyang Hui to reclaim her stolen money. As they set up an elaborate scheme against the scammers, the pair slowly develop unexpected feelings for each other amid lies, deception and twists of fate.

programme.title: Montages of a Modern Motherhood
programme.desc: Shu Zhen's life takes a sharp downturn after the birth of her daughter. Exhausted by the demands of caring for a newborn and neglected by her indifferent husband, she finds herself caught in growing family conflicts, postnatal turmoil, and unyielding work stress. Through long and lonely nights, will the dawn bring her hope or despair?

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well 2009
programme.desc: Successful businesswoman Yu Chu has no chance of finding a husband with her insufferable personality, much to the consternation of her younger brother Yu Bo, who due to a curse, will fail in love until his sister gets married. Yu Bo hires a love expert, Dick, to woo his sister. Smitten at first sight, Yu Chu is not about to let Dick get away...

programme.title: Death Stranding
programme.desc: To overhaul the underground gambling industry, the police join hands with the gambling association to crack down on illegal casinos. They auction off new casino licenses to regulate the industry, but this results in an upheaval in the gambling world, unveiling the hidden interests and secrets while sparking conflicts between gangs...

programme.title: One and Only
programme.desc: Veteran street dancer Ding Lei, invites passionate street dancer, Chen Shuo to his dance club. Sparks fly when Chen dances with the club's top dancers. Chen pursues his dream to perform but discovers that Ding has invited him for another reason. As both of them deal with hard times, can they turn the tide on the challenges that they are facing?

programme.title: Call of Heroes
programme.desc: Set in 1914 following the collapse of the Qing dynasty, the action-packed Call of Heroes tells the story of a group of villagers standing up to a cruel young warlord to protect their homeland.

programme.title: The Monkey King 2
programme.desc: Monkey King is tasked with escorting Monk Tang on his journey to the West to retrieve the scriptures. During the trip, Monk Tang is being targeted by the seductive yet deadly White Bone Spirit, who feeds on the innocents to gain immortality. Monkey King will have to fight the White Bone Spirit in order to save Monk Tang!

programme.title: The Italian Recipe
programme.desc: Famous pop idol Peng travels to Rome for a reality show and encounters an ordinary girl, Mang, who dreams of becoming a great chef after migrating to Italy. Peng and Mang have nothing in common but spend a magical night in Rome together. Their lives begin to change as the two start to fall in love.

programme.title: Iceman
programme.desc: Falsely accused of murder, Ming Dynasty Imperial Guard Ying is pursued by his three sworn brothers until a fierce battle leaves all four entombed in ice. Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: All Suspects
programme.desc: A policeman on leave checks into a B&B, sharing the space with a detective novelist, a homeless drifter and a pianist. However, when the owner and the receptionist are found dead, the peaceful retreat turns into a web of suspicion and deceit. Each guest becomes both suspect and sleuth—each guarding a secret that could unravel the entire mystery.

programme.title: Guilt By Design
programme.desc: On the final day of a shocking murder trial in Hong Kong, a renowned hypnotherapist serving as a juror receives a video showing his daughter being kidnapped. The abductors demand that he hypnotize the jury to manipulate the final verdict. Torn between justice and family, he must decide how far he is willing to go to save her.

programme.title: Love Lies
programme.desc: Gynaecologist Veronica downloads a dating app for fun. Little does she know that the charming French engineer on the other end is actually a local con artist named Joe, who is a member of an online scam group. As their fake relationship unfolds, both Joe's guilty conscience and Veronica's hopes intensify.

programme.title: Moscow Mission
programme.desc: The story is based on a 1993 true event, the "China-Russia Train Robbery" where a gang of criminals commits a heist, stealing cash and goods from the cross border train. A Chinese police officer disguises as a businessman heads the operation to arrest the criminals, but uncovers a bigger conspiracy instead…

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find “The Sutra of 42 Chapters”. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: A Legend
programme.desc: Archaeologist Professor Fang uncovers artifacts from a glacier expedition that resembles a jade pendant in his dream. To unveil the truth, Professor Fang leads his team to a journey into the glacier, embarking on a fantastical adventure together.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A Master fortune teller predicts that Tung, a born psychopath, will be imprisoned for murder and tries to change his fate. A veteran detective believes Tung is a psychopathic serial killer after witnessing him kill a cat, and pursues him relentlessly. Can the Master change Tung's mad fate?

programme.title: The Last Tycoon
programme.desc: Gangster Chen Da Qi rises to the upper echelons of power, but finds himself torn between the love of two women, the murderous plots of the secret service, and the looming threat of war.

programme.title: I Want to be Rich
programme.desc: Young Wah rises from a poverty-stricken background, carrying the heavy burden of caring for his gambling-addicted parents and younger siblings. Against all odds, his resilience and determination to provide a better life for his family eventually lead him to achieve significant success in real estate—a testament that perseverance pays off.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Set 500 years before the Monkey King Wu Kong wreaks havoc in the heavenly kingdom, the movie tells the story of how Wu Kong who, unwilling to bow to his own destiny, sets out to rebel against the gods.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Hidden Power Of Dragon Sabre
programme.desc: Defeated villain Sung Ching Shu returns and starts a reign of terror, trapping a beautiful Mongolian Princess and mastering the "yin and yang combination" to become almost invincible. Only two swords held by two great swordsmen can stand in his way!

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. David's sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Lion VS Lion
programme.desc: The traditional lion dance has never looked so good as in Lion VS Lion which captures the most impressive sequences of lion dancing on film. Besides being loaded with enjoyable martial arts chicanery, film historians can revel because it's also the first film that clearly demonstrates the intricacies and differences between the traditional Northern and Southern lion dancing techniques. The Five Venom alumnus and Chang Cheh discovery, Lo Meng, teams up with Liu Chia-liang protege Wang Yu, as they inadvertently turn from vagabond kung-fu school operators into anti-Ching, patriotic fighters.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Opium And The Kung-Fu Master
programme.desc: Tie Qiao San, head of the Ten Guangdong Tigers, is an honourable master with many disciples. As opium becomes popular among the nobles, Tie starts taking it and gradually harms his body. When an opium house's owner defeats Tie in a fight and he is only saved from being killed by his disciple, Tie vows to quit opium and get back on his feet.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friend's son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next?

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: This movie tells the tale of Lin Chong, the Sung Dynasty's Chief Army Instructor who is framed by a corrupt official and has to embark on an exile fraught with danger. Helped by a monk, Lin Chong is finally able to take revenge.

programme.title: When The Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Ode to Gallantry
programme.desc: In this surprisingly light-hearted "Venoms" martial arts adventure, a lone wanderer is repeatedly mistaken for someone else and drawn into a number of violent battles.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Legendary Weapons Of China
programme.desc: Lei Kung, the leader of the Boxer Clan in Yunnan, dissolves the clan to save his disciples before going into self-exile. The Clan sends various assassins to kill him but failed. They then assigned Kung's brother Yong to find and kill Kung, leading to a battle between the two brothers.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jin's daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Swordsman and Enchantress
programme.desc: The story happens in a martial arts world where everyone tries to obtain the "Deer Sword". Lian's wife is wounded in an ambush and his rival Xiao saves her. They escape to Xiao's home and he treats her poisonous wound. This leads Lian to suspect his wife's faithfulness and results in several blood-splattering duels with Xiao.

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?
programme.desc: Jenny Hu, Shaw Brothers' gorgeous Chinese-German star, was given her first comedy role in the wild and wacky Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers? Described as "a comedy of belly laughs and chilling murders", it is a unique entry in the Hong Kong theater of the absurd.

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: Legend Of The Fox
programme.desc: A young man, Chin, believes he is an orphan, until he meets three men and learns from them that his father was a great swordsman who was killed when he was trying to dispel rumors of a wrongdoing and return a lost sword to its rightful owner. Chin seeks out the men's help to take vengeance on the wrongful death of his father.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: The Grand Substitution
programme.desc: In this Opera epic, a loyal Imperial Court servant gives up his own newborn son to save the prince from an evil official.

programme.title: The Wandering Swordsman
programme.desc: The wandering swordsman Yu Hsieh Erh has formidable sword skills and helps the poor by robbing from thieves and distributing the wealth. He meets a group of bandits who are planning to rob a convoy escorting some valuables and is tricked into participating in the robbery. Yu soon realizes his folly and returns to take revenge on the bandits.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: Japanese director Inoue Umetsugu takes on the glitzy world of nightclub performers in The Yellow Muffler. The film depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching-ping (Irene Chen I-ling) and Pai-hung (Betty Ting Pei) and ends when they are cast in a new movie.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: The five Kao brothers, separated since birth, are unaware that the master of Teng Lung Manor has killed their father. All five however, vow to defeat the vicious gangsters at the manor due to their bullying ways. After reuniting and with much discipline and hard work, the Kaos are prepared to face Lung and his gang.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: Perils Of The Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Chu Liuxiang and the Eighth Prince stage a fake assassination attempt, allowing Chu to infiltrate Ghostly Manor as an undercover agent and eradicate this den of evil. The manor harbours notorious martial arts criminals and is rumoured to be haunted. Soon, during his investigation, Chu becomes entangled in a series of mysterious and eerie events.

programme.title: The Mirror and the Lichee
programme.desc: The curious title in this Huangmei Opera romance refers to the two props that signal a happy beginning between a scholar and a local beauty. The scholar polishes mirrors so as to be closer to his love, who signals her approval by tossing him some lichees. From that point on the course of their love becomes rocky, complete with murder and suicide.

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Bao's chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named “The Fastest Sword” but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: Little Dragon Maiden
programme.desc: Yang Guo and Xiao Long Nu are deeply in love and live harmoniously in the ancient tomb. Xiao Long Nu proposes marriage one day but Yang Guo declines. Heartbroken, she leaves without a word. Devastated by her absence, Yang Guo searches tirelessly for her. When they finally reunite, he begs her to marry him—only for her to refuse his proposal.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: A vicious Japanese judo expert wants to prove that Chinese are the “sick people of Asia” and sets out to sabotage and kill the best martial artists in dangerous tournaments. To save his son from this, the head of Ping Pai Boxing Institute sends him to the mountains to learn the powerful Thunderbolt Fist technique from master fighter, Red Butterfly.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: Inside The Forbidden City
programme.desc: Justice Bao discovers that Consort Li's new born son was swapped at birth and that she was expelled from the palace by Empress Liu twenty years ago. He sets Eunuch Guo up to confess his conspiracy with the Empress. Empress Liu is convicted for her act and Consort Li finally reunites with her son who is now the Emperor.

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during China's early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber(1977)
programme.desc: Adapted from the great Chinese classic novel of the same name, the son of renowned Jia family, Bao Yu, is deeply in love with his cousin, Dai Yu. However, his mother disapproves of their relationship and plots to arrange Bao Yu to marry another rich girl, resulting in a tragic ending for the perfect couple.

programme.title: Usurpers Of Emperor's Power
programme.desc: The last ruler of Tang, Li Yao is deposed by Chao Kuang-jun, the founder of the Sung Dynasty. Unfortunately his actions unleash a new plague - his brother Kuang-yi - on the courts and his people. The marauding Kuang-yi rapes and plunders. As more people get involved, it turns into a bloody battlefield of betrayal. It is up to upright officials like Li Lang to put an end to it. But can one man take on the imperial army?

programme.title: Love Parade
programme.desc: Fashion designer Shi asks his friend Mui to comment on his new design but is angered by her criticism. When Mui asks him to design a gown for her to attend a gala event, Shi takes revenge by making a clown costume instead. Seeing Mui's embarrassment, Shi feels guilty and apologizes to her, before they fall in love…

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlong's younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles…

programme.title: Na Cha The Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend “Investiture of the Gods”, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: The Lark
programme.desc: Sixties pop star Carrie Ku plays the "Little Lark" in this romantic-drama of mistaken identity that is a treasure trove of some of the most popular Mandarin songs of all time.

programme.title: The Golden Knight
programme.desc: The heroine Yu Fei Xia is accused of stealing the book of martial arts secrets. To prove her innocence, she disguises herself as a man and finds her way into the Shaolin Temple to find out the truth…

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the family's young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huo's stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriend's baby...

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind…

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master are slain by the ruthless bandit, Centipede, Su Can embarks on a perilous quest for revenge.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

programme.title: The Kingdom And The Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his father's death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident…

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husband's death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal
programme.desc: Roam across America with a road-tripping chicken and meet a mouse family living in an English garden. Beat arachnophobia with a spider's help, trek with the guardian of Earth's last two northern white rhinos, and celebrate more interspecies pals.

programme.title: My Best Friend's An Animal
programme.desc: Learn how cockatoos and platypuses inspired new careers, then explore the shared trauma that bonded a human and an elephant for life. Get playful with 35-year-old George the turkey vulture and say a moving farewell to human-raised kangaroos.

programme.title: Wildest New Zealand
programme.desc: New Zealand's isolated islands are famed as an unusual paradise, home to a variety of unique wildlife. Best known for its flightless birds, ancient reptiles and coastal mammals, a closer look reveals another world. A land of miniature monsters, Lilliputian predators and tiny terrors that lead remarkable lives, where every hunter is also the hunted and survival is always a giant struggle. Journey into the undergrowth and discover life on a different scale. From giant carnivorous centipedes and nocturnal crickets to fishing spiders and glowing worms with silken traps. Weird and wonderful, these unsung heroes are Wildest New Zealand's Creepiest Crawlies.

programme.title: Superbeast
programme.desc: Bow down to one of nature's most ancient and deadly endurance predators. Watch tiger sharks exploit turtle nesting chaos, survive oxygen-poor environments with epaulette sharks, and withstand the crushing pressure of the deep with ghost sharks.

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue
programme.desc: Meet a flock of cedar waxwings who have taken over the center's aviary and are keeping the staff busy with endless demands for food. Then the rescue team works with the Ministry of Natural Resources to relocate a coyote that's too people-friendly.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends
programme.desc: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a troop of rescue center monkeys that have adopted a litter of stray kittens, a loyal dog helping a rescued raccoon overcome her fears, and an emu raised by Irish setters.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild
programme.desc: In central Namibia, a pack of painted wolves roams the arid land. Amid threats from lions and drought, a plucky little pup called Lyca has to grow up fast, learn the skills of a hunter, and find her place as member of the pack.

programme.title: New Kids In The Wild
programme.desc: In South Africa's Greater Kruger Park, A little cub called Chiga has been born into family of hunters - the Mala Mala lion pride. Under the guidance of a devoted father, a fierce mother, and a playful sister, Chiga finds her place in the pride.

programme.title: New Kids In The Wild
programme.desc: Usana, a cheetah cub is born with the odds stacked against her. Few cheetah cubs make it through their first year. Lucky for her, she's got an amazing mother who will stop at nothing to keep her cubs safe. Usana might just follow in her footsteps.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild
programme.desc: In Brazil's Serra da Capivara, Chico, the baby capuchin monkey is learning to integrate into a troop with complicated rules, and exploring a forest full of excitement and danger. But mastering the art of tool use holds the key to his survival.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild
programme.desc: In India, Ravi the baby lion-tailed macaque faces life in a shrinking habitat and encroaching human world. Luckily he has a caring mum, a protective dad, a playful sister, and numerous, cousins, aunts and uncles all watching over him.

programme.title: A Bee's Diary
programme.desc: In a beehive, tens of thousands of tiny animals work toward a common goal: the survival of the colony. But what is life like for an individual honeybee? A Bee's Diary tells that story.

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa
programme.desc: In a park where land meets sea, the natural elements combine to create wonderful variety. Cola-colored water feeds forests green and dense. Fire and wind fuel growth in great diversity and rock shapes a coastline of many faces. Life thrives here - from the magnificent to the bizarre. This is the Garden Route National Park.

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa
programme.desc: In the northern reaches of the Kruger National Park, life depends on one thing - water. In a land burdened by heat and drought a single ribbon cuts its reliable course through the wilderness. It's a lifeline to all creatures, great and small.

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa
programme.desc: Augrabies is where the mighty Orange River plunges over the awesome 56 meter Augrabies waterfall. Derived from a word “oukurubes” which means “place of thunder” in the indigenous language of the Nama-Khoi this land is the heart of a harsh and sun-beaten world with flashes of brilliant color and a thunderous roar.

programme.title: Great Parks Of Africa
programme.desc: Food, water and shelter are essential to all life on earth from the smallest of beings to the largest, and along the banks of one of Africa's greatest rivers, some animals struggle while others thrive. A rhythm drives all animals as they journey in search of what they need to survive, and each must decide where and when to move if they're to succeed... These are the magical worlds of the Lower Zambezi.

programme.title: Wild Science
programme.desc: Trace the lion's rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts.

programme.title: Wild Science
programme.desc: Confront the ocean's most versatile and formidable predator. Learn about the biological advantages that helped this prehistoric species survive multiple mass extinctions, then get awed by the relentless hunting skills of bull sharks.

programme.title: Wild Science
programme.desc: Revisit the evolutionary journey of brown bears, from ursid ancestors that dominated the ice ages to today's modern omnivores. Witness their symbiotic relationship with salmon and the surprisingly interconnected ecosystems they thrive in.

programme.title: Wild Science
programme.desc: Follow the journey of the black rhino and see how adaptation and conservation have influenced the evolution of an ancient titan of nature. Experience this armoured herbivore's extraordinary hearing, sense of smell, and other biological advantages.

programme.title: Guardians of the Wild
programme.desc: Across Africa 97% of black rhinos have been killed for their horns. In 1997 the species was declared officially extinct in Zambia. But a small, dedicated team are fighting to keep them safe. This is the frontline of conservation - it doesn't get any tougher.

programme.title: Guardians Of The Wild

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, including “ranch manager” Barclay, a Great Dane who happens to be a gifted horse whisperer. In Africa, a tiny marmoset called Thor has become obsessed with two young rescued mongooses.

programme.title: Land Of Primates
programme.desc: The gelada is a rare monkey that lives in the Simien Mountains of Ethiopia. They're charismatic, vocal, and mix affection and confrontation. Watch as they face the challenges of their habitat—and each other.

programme.title: Land Of Primates
programme.desc: Enter the wilds of South Africa to get an intimate look into one of the continent's most misunderstood primates. Like humans, these primates have unique personalities and share strong bonds with their families and friends.

programme.title: Land Of Primates
programme.desc: As humans take up more space, the baboons of Africa must adapt. Travel across the continent to watch them form unbreakable social bonds, serve to protect their families and survive a changing landscape.

programme.title: Land Of Primates
programme.desc: Off the coast of Tanzania, baby Kima lives with his family of red Colobus monkeys. But what happens when he loses his way? Discover how this little monkey learns to adapt to life in the jungle—and find out if he can reconnect with his family again.

programme.title: Colombia's Wild Coast
programme.desc: Gorgona was once home to Colombia's Alcatraz. Modelled on Nazi concentration camps, prisoners dreamt of escape. See the island's stunning wildlife through the eyes of a convict on the run, the monkeys, snakes and sloths who've now reclaimed the land.

programme.title: Colombia's Wild Coast
programme.desc: On the island of Providencia, a black crab begins the mission of her life, escorting 80,000 eggs from her home, on a 3 km hike to the coast. Join her, and millions of her clan, on a journey fraught with danger, where chances of survival are slim.

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Deal with duelling duckling roundups and find out if vet Karina calls in specialists to treat koala Spike's leg fracture. Get to the bottom of stomach issues plaguing baby echidnas Ping and Pong, and meet koala Jarrah, who seems to have lost his way.

programme.title: Wildlife ER
programme.desc: Contend with a flood of abandoned koala joeys, then join vet nurse Nick on a hunt for natural remedies to treat a wallaby's gut ailment. Ponder options for a baby bat stuck in a tree and look on as vet Karina operates on a barn owl's fractured wing.

programme.title: The Living Beach
programme.desc: Florida is famous for its sandy shores—and there's plenty to go around. Florida has the most tidal shoreline of any state in the continental USA. These ocean-side playgrounds are also critical habitats for threatened and endangered species.

programme.title: The Living Beach
programme.desc: At either edge of the province, Nova Scotia proves that any beach is built from raw forces in opposition, but also that balance between those forces is necessary if life is to thrive.

programme.title: The Great Elephant Tale
programme.desc: Follow the adventures of three elephants across three very distinct African habitats. Their travels combine to tell the story of how these emotional and intelligent creatures evolved over millions of years to survive on the continent.

programme.title: Tusker: Brotherhood of Elephants
programme.desc: Become immersed in the intricate lives of tuskers with Craig, Pascal, and Esau, three male African elephants in all stages of life. Get a rare glimpse into the subtle language, complex interactions, and deep bonds of the world's largest land mammal.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year
programme.desc: In Southern Africa, Spring starts in early September and the natural world stirs into life. Days begin to lengthen, temperatures rise, and animals and plants combine in an orchestrated effort to reproduce, give birth and raise their young.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year
programme.desc: Summer in Africa is a season of extremes, it separates the weak from the strong. It tests the survival instincts of cheetahs, lions, geckos, turtles and many more species as they search for food and water in the extreme heat of summer.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year
programme.desc: Autumn in Africa brings opportunities. Cape Fur seals, Samango monkeys, chameleons, impala, and more respond to the season. Autumn triggers changes in the lives of many animals. Rare creatures reveal themselves and predators gather to take advantage.

programme.title: Africa's Wild Year
programme.desc: Be an eyewitness to the death and resurrection that winter brings to Africa. Observe what comes with shorter days, from drought conditions to frigid winds, and marvel at the survival skills of animals and plants as they face the season's fury.

programme.title: (L) UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos - Main
programme.desc: As UFC returns to the Meta APEX on Saturday, September 27, it does so with a stacked fight card headlined by a critical bantamweight main event between Raul “El Nino Problema” Rosas Jr. and Raoni Barcelos. The youngest fighter to win a UFC bout, Rosas Jr. makes his first main event appearance four years after earning the opportunity to compete on the biggest stage in the sport with a win on Dana White's Contender Series. Since then, the now 21-year-old has posted a 6-1 record and five straight victories, including a win over perennial contender Rob Font in March at UFC 326. Though not quite the oldest fighter in the division, Barcelos is one of bantamweight's elder statesmen, but his performance has never been better as he carries a five-fight winning streak that includes victories over rising star Payton Talbott and former champ Cody Garbrandt into his first UFC main event.

programme.title: SALAM SANTAI
programme.desc: Assalamualaikum...Mulakan hari anda dengan SALAMfm-Salam Untuk Semua. Kami temani malam anda dengan segmen Salam Santai bermula pukul 12.00 tengah malam hingga 4 pagi dengan pelbagai pengisian program Islamik menarik dan hiburan yang mendidik jiwa.

programme.title: INTERAKSI 2026
programme.desc: Jom sertai program santai yang memberi peluang pendengar untuk berinteraksi bersama DJ menerusi topik-topik Islamik yang berbeza setiap minggu.

programme.title: KELUARGA USTAZ AQIL 2026
programme.desc: Drama berunsur Islamik yang menampilkan Ustaz Aqil dibintangi Ustaz PU Rahmat sebagai watak utama dan dj-dj SALAMfm sebagai pelakon tambahan tentunya akan menarik halwa telinga anda. Nantikan istimewa hanya di SALAMfm.

programme.title: TAMADUN ISLAM 2026
programme.desc: Kami kongsikan kepada anda perincian mengenai kisah Sirah dan tokoh-tokoh Islam terkemuka serta tidak ketinggalan kisah keagungan peradaban Islam.

programme.title: HARI INI DALAM SEJARAH (HIDS)
programme.desc: Setiap hari ada sejarah yang tercipta...ikuti apakah peristiwa yang berlaku setiap hari dalam HIDS

programme.title: KAK BEDAH TUDUNG BAWAL 2026
programme.desc: Celoteh Islamik berunsur nasihat yang ringkas namun padat ini mengandungi nasihat keagamaan disampaikan Kak Bedah yang sinonim dengan pemakaian tudung bawal sebagai identitinya yang tersendiri. Melalui pendekatan yang bersahaja tapi penuh makna ini, diharapkan mesej Islam dapat disampaikan dengan lebih mudah difahami dan diamalkan.

programme.title: TADARUS 2026
programme.desc: Hayati alunan bacaan ayat-ayat suci Al-Quran setiap hari mengikut turutan juzuk dan surah dalam Al-Quran.

programme.title: NIDA UL ISLAM 2026
programme.desc: Dengarkan kapsul Nida Ul Islam di mana penceramah akan memberikan tazkirah atau perkongsian pendek berkisarkan isu-isu semasa dan terkini selama 3-5 minit

programme.title: LUGHATUL SALAM 2026
programme.desc: Mengenal, mempelajari,menghayati dan bertutur dalam pelbagai bahasa dalam kapsul Lughatul Salam terbitan Yunie Yunos

programme.title: GLOSARI ISLAM 2026
programme.desc: Kenali dan pelajari kosa kata @ maksud perkataan Islamik seperti falak, ruksah,hijab dan banyak lagi dalam Glosari Islam.

programme.title: MUZIK SALAM
programme.desc: Ikuti slot khas yang memutarkan lagu-lagu nasyid dalam Carta Salam.

programme.title: HALAQAH HADIS 2026
programme.desc: Dengarkan bacaan hadis ,terjemahan dan penjelasan di sebalik maksud hadis-hadis sahih yang ada.

programme.title: KALAMULLAH 2026
programme.desc: Hayati dan isi rohani kita dengan alunan ayat-ayat suci Al-Quran menerusi Kalamullah.

programme.title: PAGI@SALAM 2026
programme.desc: Assalamualaikum...Pagi@Salam bermula pukul 4 hingga 8 pagi, menemani anda dengan lagu-lagu ketuhanan dan nasyid kotemporari dan program-program Islamik yang menjentik jiwa.

programme.title: KONA MAI 2026
programme.desc: Rehatkan minda anda pada penghujung hari bersama Shah, Faruk & Mimie dalam segmen KONA MAI. Segmen ini membawakan pilihan lagu santai, pengisian rohani, serta seleksi lagu-lagu kesukaan anda di Tapaw Lagu @ Kafe Muzik. Sebelum melelapkan mata, nikmati alunan lagu-lagu melankolik terkini, bahasa Melayu, Inggeris, dan Indonesia untuk menemani malam anda dengan penuh kedamaian.

programme.title: GENG PAGI MUTIARA
programme.desc: Mulakan Pagi anda dengan penuh bersemangat bersama Chombi dan Bambam!\\n Segmen ini menyajikan gabungan lengkap untuk memulakan hari anda dengan positif—daripada pengisian rohani menerusi bacaan Al-Quran, nasyid, dan Santai Nurani, hinggalah kepada berita sahih, laporan trafik semasa, tajuk-tajuk akhbar utama, serta topik pagi yang santai dan menghiburkan. Jangan lupa layan lagu-lagu permintaan anda dalam slot Layan Pagi sebelum melangkah ke tengah hari!

programme.title: FOKUS MUTIARA
programme.desc: Sambil buat kerja atau berehat, penyampai kami Azie, Elly , Mimie & Fazrinah sedia menemani dengan pelbagai maklumat berguna dan hiburan menarik. Dapatkan petua serta tips gaya hidup serta pelbagai perkongsian harian yang terkini. Nikmati juga kelainan irama Bollywood menerusi Syoknya Hindi & mengimbau memori menerusi Everlasting Memory dengan lagu retro Inggeris terbaik serta laporan berita Warta Mutiara secara langsung bagi memastikan anda sentiasa peka dengan isu semasa.

programme.title: PETANG KREW
programme.desc: Petang anda pastinya tidak hambar bersama gandingan serasi Amin , Que , Mimie dan Fazrinah! Sambil melayan perjalanan pulang dari kerja, dapatkan pengisian Mutiara Ilmu, tips keusahawanan dalam Biz On Air, serta bincangkan pelbagai Isu hangat dan menarik menerusi Ralet Cheq. Tak lengkap petang anda tanpa menguji minda dalam peraduan Teka Tiara Nyanyi bersama kemaskini trafik dan berita terkini.

programme.title: SANTAI 5-8
programme.desc: Segmen Santai 5-8 mengandungi zon muzik segmen Lagu 60 an pada Isnin Laguku Kuasa Dua pada Selasa Rabu Lagu dan Kenangan Khamis Secangkir Bicara/Nurul Al-Quran dan Jumaat La Khobar. Sabtu dan Ahad segmen Hello Hello MELAKAfm pilihan lagu dan ucapan pendengar

programme.title: GEGAU PAGI 6-10
programme.desc: Seri Pagi dimulakan dengan Bacaan Al-Quran & Terjemahan seterusnya rancangan Permata Hati dan Kapsul Motivasi Jana Minda. Info Cuaca dan Berita MELAKAfm. Info trafik(call out) dan Topik Gegau Pagi interaktif bersama pendengar.Kokenut Shake Dulu Special (Temubual/Zon Iklan menyusul selepasnya. Pada Hari Sabtu pula rancangan Yok Donga Be bersiaran melibatkan tiga negeri Zon Selatan iaitu Melaka, Negeri Sembilan dan Johor secara interaktif. Sementara pada Hari Ahad Mari Berpantun(interaktif)seni budaya warisan kita.

programme.title: Pesona 10-2
programme.desc: Pendengar berpeluang memberi ucapan kepada orang yang tersayang dan membuat permintaan lagu menerusi ruangan Laguku Untukmu, bermula jam 11 pagi. Turut disajikan rancangan Dialog 1:30, program temu bual bersama Jabatan Kerajaan dan agensi-agensi berkaitan dengan memfokuskan topik-topik berkaitan situasi semasa. Rancangan keagamaan seperti Mutiara Ilmu, Fiqh Nisa dan Dari Kamar Syariah pula diserikan pada setiap Jumaat.

programme.title: Panorama 2-5
programme.desc: Santai bersama lagu-lagu tempatan dan antarabangsa terbaik menerusi ruangan 'Zon Muzik setiap Isnin jam 3 petang. Pada setiap Selasa, info-info menarik mengenai kenderaan dikongsikan menerusi rancangan 'Vromm??'. Pendengar juga akan menikmati keindahan warisan budaya negeri Melaka menerusi 'Dondang Sayang' jam 3 petang, Rabu dan 'Persada Pantun' jam 3 petang, Khamis. Turut disajikan rancangan keagamaan seperti 'Secangkir Bicara: Biar Santai Janji Sampai' dan 'Nurul Quran' \"La khobar\"pada setiap Jumaat. Sabtu dan Ahad diserikan dengan Silang Budaya/Stesen Berkembar Suara Bertemu Suara Satu Suara Satu Jiwa.

programme.title: Relaks Mfm 8-12
programme.desc: Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan Santai Buskers dan juga Dari Studio Muzik. Seleksi lagu-lagu ketuhanan melayari Khamis malam Jumaat anda. Turut Hangatkan malam Isnin anda dengan seleksi lagu terbaik menerusi 'Janji Rock' bersama DJ Lia. 'Salam Namaste' pula menemui anda setiap Selasa dengan seleksi lagu-lagu Bollywood dan Hindustan. 'Layan Muzik' akan menghiburkan malam Rabu dengan rancangan IN-TREND pilihan lagu-lagu baru. Seleksi lagu-lagu dalam Senada Duet melayari malam Khamis anda Malam Bunga Bunga Cinta untuk yang curhat pada malam Jumaat bersama DJ Ain. Turut disajikan 'Waronk Dangdut pada Sabtu dan Syok 80-90 pada Ahad.

programme.title: Signal 1203
programme.desc: Signal 1203 – The Midnight Experience on REDfm\\\\n\\\\nGet ready for a brand-new late-night adventure with Signal 1203, your ultimate companion from 12am to 3am on REDfm for Variety! This isn’t just another radio show – it’s a full-on experience. Dive into fresh, youth-focused content, spine-chilling horror stories that will keep you on the edge of your seat, and trending topics that matter to you. We have Technology, Horror, chillout music, movie reviews, crime drama and so much more!\\\\n\\\\nAnd of course, what’s a night show without killer music? We’ve got the best tracks to keep your vibe alive through the early hours. Whether you’re up late studying, driving, or just chilling, Signal 1203 is your signal for something different.\\\\n\\\\nStay tuned. Stay awake. Stay connected. Only on REDfm – for variety.\\\\n\\\\n

programme.title: Morning Music 音乐早点
programme.desc: 《音乐早点》你最贴心的早间声音伴侣。我们不聊冗长的资讯，只精选最舒缓、最动听的旋律，配合清新的晨间絮语，为你卸去昨夜的疲惫，装满清晨的能量。无论你正行走在通勤的路上，还是在享用一份惬意的早餐，让《音乐早点》用惬意的乐音，陪你开启美好而有温度的一天。

programme.title: Midday Mix Part 1
programme.desc: Playing you the best hits from the past to current hits, along with news, interviews and interesting topics.

programme.title: MIDDAY MIX PART 2
programme.desc: Our variety program for the afternoon. 1pm - 4pm. Great music, fun DJs and total entertainment for 3 hours!!

programme.desc: 星期一道星期六，下午4-5点，忙碌的午后，需要适时的暂停。《音乐下午茶》 是一档专为午后时光打造的治愈系音乐随笔节目。

programme.title: 下班开麦啦
programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.title: Top 20 红人音乐流行榜

programme.title: 同学八宝箱
programme.desc: 嗨，小朋友们！欢迎来到《同学八宝箱》！这是一个藏着无数秘密和惊喜的超级宝箱！只要轻敲三下，里面就会跳出好听的童话故事、神奇的科学冷知识，还有超级爆笑的校园趣事！无论是在上学路上、放学途中，还是睡前的陪伴时刻，快和我们一起打开八宝箱，收获满满的快乐和智慧吧！

programme.title: City Papago 城市趴趴走
programme.desc: 真正的旅行，不在于去过多少地方，而在于是否真正融入过当地的生活。《城市趴趴走》带你跳出千篇一律的旅游攻略，走进各大城市的街头巷尾。我们带你探寻历史街区的建筑余温，打卡本地人流连的菜市场与深夜食堂，听原住民讲述古老而新鲜的故事。从古朴小镇到摩登都市，请收拾好心情，随我们一起漫步街头，体验最地道、最富有烟火气的城市微旅行。

programme.title: 下班开麦啦
programme.desc: 叮！下班铃声响起，属于你自己的时间正式开始。《下班开麦啦》是你在晚高峰通勤路上最懂你的“解压陪伴站”。告别繁琐的工作汇报和烦人的KPI，这里只有轻松搞笑的职场吐槽、热辣接地气的社会热议，以及最治愈的音乐与故事。无论你正挤在拥挤的地铁里，还是堵在回家的车流中，戴上耳机，和我们一起开麦畅聊，把一天的疲惫一扫而空！

programme.title: 听歌好时光
programme.desc: 忙碌的生活里，你有多久没有好好听完一首歌了？这里是《听歌好时光》，你的私享音乐会客厅。我们不设复杂的门槛，没有沉重的叙事，只挑选最惬意、最动听的旋律，为你揉碎日常的喧嚣。沏一杯清茶，或是斟一杯咖啡，在这个专属的空间里，让我们用好歌慢下来，静静享受属于你的好时光。

programme.title: 孤芳自赏
programme.desc: 在快节奏与商业大片的喧喧嚷嚷之外，总有一些电影选择安静地立于角落，散发着独一无二的光芒。这里是《孤芳自赏》，一处专属于高冷影迷与独立电影的声音（视觉）放映厅。\n\n我们带你穿透繁复的光影，解读那些被低估的冷门佳作、艺术大师的独行之作，以及镜头深处最隐秘的人性角落。不追热门，不作媚俗之语。今夜，让我们在独立的光影世界里，孤芳自赏。

programme.title: SEGMEN HARMONIKA (1700-1900)
programme.desc:
Harmonika merupakan segmen siaran petang ke malam KENINGAUfm yang menekankan keharmonian emosi, muzik dan kehidupan. Bersiaran dari jam 5 hingga 7 malam, segmen ini menjadi pengiring setia pendengar ketika waktu pulang dari kerja, dalam perjalanan, atau berehat bersama keluarga menjelang malam.

Segmen ini menyajikan lagu-lagu malar segar, balada, nostalgia dan pilihan pendengar yang menenangkan jiwa, diselang-selikan dengan perkongsian santai, refleksi ringan dan kisah kehidupan yang menyentuh perasaan. 

Harmonika turut membuka ruang interaksi dua hala melalui dedikasi lagu, kiriman mesej dan ucapan daripada pendengar, menjadikan segmen ini dekat dan peribadi. Di samping hiburan, segmen ini menyelitkan kata-kata positif, nilai kekeluargaan dan mesej kemanusiaan, sesuai untuk menutup hari dengan rasa damai dan seimbang.

Segmen ini bukan sekadar hiburan muzik, tetapi sebuah ruang harmoni yang menyatukan perasaan, kenangan dan harapan pendengar dalam alunan petang menuju malam.

programme.title: SEGMEN RENTAK SEGAR (0600-0900)
programme.desc: Segmen Rentak Segar – Permulaan Hari dengan Energi Positif di KENINGAUfm! Rentak Segar merupakan segmen siaran Bahasa Malaysia yang membuka tirai pagi di KENINGAUfm, bersiaran setiap hari dari pukul 6:00 hingga 9:00 pagi. Segmen ini menjadi pilihan utama pendengar di pedalaman Sabah untuk memulakan hari dengan maklumat terkini, hiburan, dan motivasi pagi yang segar.

programme.title: SEGMEN DUSUN-KUHOI ARAMAI BOH (0900-1200)
programme.desc: Kuhoi Aramai Boh merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Dusun yang bersifat ceria, mesra komuniti dan sarat nilai budaya, disiarkan setiap pagi dari jam 9 hingga 12 tengah hari. Segmen ini menjadi ruang kebersamaan untuk pendengar berkongsi cerita, gelak tawa, dan maklumat bermanfaat dalam suasana santai seperti berkumpul sesama keluarga.\n\nSepanjang tempoh siaran, pendengar disajikan dengan lagu-lagu Dusun dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berunsur hiburan, motivasi dan kehidupan seharian, serta perkongsian isu komuniti setempat. Interaksi langsung bersama pendengar melalui panggilan telefon, WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu mengukuhkan hubungan dua hala antara penyampai dan komuniti.

programme.title: SEGMEN MURUT- PAGAYAMAN TAKAW MONSOI (1200-1500)
programme.desc:
Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi merupakan segmen siaran bahasa Murut yang mengangkat semangatperkongsian dan kebersamaan yang harmoni bersama komuniti. Bersiaran setiap hari dari jam 12 hingga 3 petang.

Segmen ini mengetengahkan lagu-lagu Murut dan tempatan pilihan, perbualan ringan berkenaan kehidupan harian, budaya, adat resam serta kisah komuniti pedalaman, di samping perkongsian maklumat semasa yang dekat dengan realiti pendengar. 

Interaksi dua hala menjadi kekuatan utama Pagayaman Takaw Monsoi melalui panggilan telefon, pesanan WhatsApp dan dedikasi lagu, sekali gus memberi ruang kepada pendengar untuk bersuara, berkongsi cerita dan menyampaikan salam kekeluargaan. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata nasihat, nilai murni dan mesej kemasyarakatan, menjadikannya bukan sahaja menghiburkan, malah menyatukan dan memperkukuh jati diri komuniti dikawasan Pedalaman.

programme.title: SEGMEN SANTAI PETANG (1500-1700)
programme.desc:
Santai Petang merupakan segmen siaran yang menemani pendengar KENINGAUfm pada waktu peralihan dari rutin kerja ke suasana petang yang lebih tenang. Bersiaran dari jam 3 hingga 5 petang, segmen ini membawa pendekatan santai, ringan dan menghiburkan, sesuai dinikmati ketika dalam perjalanan pulang, berehat di rumah atau masih di tempat kerja.

Segmen ini menghidangkan lagu-lagu pilihan tempatan dan popular, diselang-selikan dengan sembang santai, perkongsian kisah harian, isu ringan semasa, serta topik-topik dekat dengan kehidupan pendengar.

Interaksi bersama pendengar menjadi elemen utama Santai Petang, melalui kiriman WhatsApp, dedikasi lagu dan respons spontan terhadap pandangan pendengar. Segmen ini turut menyelitkan kata-kata motivasi ringkas, info bermanfaat dan mesej positif, menjadikan ia bukan sekadar hiburan, tetapi juga ruang untuk melepaskan tekanan dan menutup hari dengan emosi yang lebih baik.

programme.desc: SAMPI PAGI/PANTUN BULAN/KATA KATA MOTIVASI

programme.title: Warna-Warni Asia
programme.desc: Sebuah rancangan travelog membawa penonton melihat tempat-tempat menarik dalam Asia yang berwarna-warni.

programme.title: Advokasi Alam
programme.desc: Ikuti pengembaraan Oma (Datin Norelan Ismail), bersama cucunya, Dina Melan menjelajah ke seluruh negara dan bertemu rakan-rakan aktivis pecinta alam dalam rancangan Advokasi Alam.

programme.title: Simfoni Alam
programme.desc: Dokumentari memaparkan isu hidupan liar dan alam semula jadi.

programme.title: Dive Mission
programme.desc: Jaslin Puasa dalam misi untuk mendokumentasikan kesan perubahan semua iklim dan menyelam di beberapa tapak selaman.

programme.title: The Travelling Foodie
programme.desc: An English-language food magazine programme exploring Malaysia’s diverse culinary landscape, featuring a variety of local dishes, flavours, food traditions and culinary experiences from across the country.

programme.title: DUNIA MELAYU - LEGASI MARITIM MELAYU
programme.desc: Legasi Maritim Melayu is a documentary segment under Dunia Melayu that explores the rich maritime heritage of the Malay civilisation. The programme highlights the ingenuity and achievements of the Malay people in navigation, shipbuilding, seafaring knowledge, and maritime trade, showcasing their historical role as skilled sailors and influential players in regional and international maritime networks.

programme.title: Mukjizat Dan Sains
programme.desc: A programme exploring the scientific and technological dimensions of selected Quranic verses, highlighting their relevance to modern scientific discoveries and knowledge. Hosted by Associate Professor Dato’ Dr. Mohd Izhar Ariff, the programme offers an insightful perspective on the relationship between the Quran, science and technology.

programme.title: Ilmuan Islamiah
programme.desc: A programme exploring the development of various fields of knowledge pioneered and advanced by prominent Islamic scholars and thinkers. Each episode features two influential figures — a historical scholar and a contemporary thinker — highlighting their contributions, ideas and lasting impact on their respective fields.

programme.title: Iqra'
programme.desc: A Quran learning programme focused on talaqqi and guided Quran reading, helping viewers of all ages learn to read the Quran correctly with proper tajwid and pronunciation.

programme.title: Nawaitu
programme.desc: A programme exploring the importance of intention (niat) as the foundation of every action, through real-life stories and experiences within society. It highlights how sincere intentions can transform good deeds into acts of worship, while misguided intentions may lead to unintended consequences, guided by teachings from the Quran and Hadith.

programme.title: Kata Sifu
programme.desc: A mentorship programme featuring accomplished experts from selected fields as Sifus (mentors) who share their knowledge, skills and experience with their mentees. Hosted by Wanns Ahmad, the programme offers an engaging platform for learning, guidance and personal growth.

programme.title: Kota Warisan Alam
programme.desc: A travelogue exploring Malaysia’s heritage cities, showcasing their unique history, culture, natural attractions and interesting places for visitors to discover. Each episode takes viewers on a journey through the country’s heritage destinations and highlights experiences worth exploring.

programme.title: Warisan Kita
programme.desc: An engaging programme for general audiences that showcases Malaysia’s rich heritage, highlighting the country’s diverse cultural traditions, customs, arts and historical legacy.

programme.title: Etnik Kita
programme.desc: A travelogue following host Alif Hadi as he journeys across Malaysia to discover the lives, cultures and traditions of the country’s minority ethnic communities, offering viewers a closer look at their unique heritage and way of life.

programme.title: Lagu Negaraku
programme.desc: Negaraku is the national anthem of Malaysia, symbolising the nation’s sovereignty, unity, and patriotism.

programme.title: GLOBAL - ON THE TABLE
programme.desc: In this latest episode of On The Table, the discussion explores how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is reshaping the future of work and transforming modern workplaces. The programme looks at the changing nature of jobs, evolving workplace skills, and how organisations and employees can adapt to an increasingly AI-driven working environment.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: This episode (76), present various cultural traditions, agricultural shifts, and economic impacts around the globe, starting with the deep cultural importance of traditional Afghan flatbread (naan) as a staple of hospitality and daily life, alongside France's globally renowned cheese industry, which blends ancestral production methods with modern certification systems to protect its vital economic and heritage status. It also showcases Malaysia's tourism appeal through recurring promotional segments emphasizing its rich heritage and natural beauty. On the economic front, the video examines how the FIFA World Cup drives global commerce, particularly through Chinese manufacturers rapidly scaling the production of Lionel Messi plush toys to monetize high fan engagement. Additionally, it covers the strategic shift in northwest Syria's Idlib province toward low-water, high-value saffron cultivation to revive the war-torn economy, and concludes with the major resurgence of indigenous, nutrient-rich foods in Zimbabwe, where cities like Bulawayo are seeing an increase in traditional restaurants helping to promote healthier lifestyles and preserve national identity.

programme.title: GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE : MALAYSIA'S REGIONAL DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS
programme.desc: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, Malaysia has prioritized an \"ASEAN First\" foreign policy centered on deepening diplomatic ties, honest communication, and mutual respect with its neighbors to bolster economic and regional stability. This cooperative framework is materialized through major high-value cross-border projects with Singapore, such as the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JSSEZ) and the Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link, which aim to enhance digital economy integrations, secure sustainable skilled employment, and improve labor mobility. Furthermore, during its 2025 ASEAN Chairmanship focused on inclusivity and sustainability, Malaysia expanded the regional architecture by admitting Timor-Leste, charting the long-term \"ASEAN 2045\" strategic vision, and demonstrating its diplomatic efficacy by facilitating a swift 24-hour ceasefire between Cambodia and Thailand. Ultimately, these parallel security and geoeconomic strategies—such as releasing a historical communique regarding Palestine/Gaza and maintaining stable dialogue over the South China Sea—reinforce ASEAN centrality while driving Malaysia forward to attract major global investments and position Southeast Asia as a resilient, high-value global economic hub.

programme.title: ASEAN - RASA ASEAN
programme.desc: Rasa Asean, is a culinary travel program involving the tastes of food from Asean countries with Chef Fikri and Chef Naim who will also produce and serve the stories behind the traditional food.

programme.title: Asean Women Entrepreneurship
programme.desc: Episode 1 features the stories and entrepreneurial journeys of three women entrepreneurs from ASEAN — Christy Ng (Malaysia), Boutsaya Viengviseth (Laos), and Nikha Akhsaniyati Kholisoh (Indonesia) — as they build their businesses, overcome challenges, and unlock new opportunities. The programme highlights their entrepreneurial spirit, creativity, and the vital role of women in driving economic growth across the ASEAN region.

programme.title: ASEAN - JEJAK HALAL ASEAN
programme.desc: A travelogue exploring the diverse cultures, traditions and everyday lives of Muslim communities across ASEAN. This episode of Jejak Halal ASEAN takes viewers on a journey through Satun, Thailand, discovering its rich Islamic heritage, halal culture and unique local way of life.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - KALAM WAHYU (TILAWAH)
programme.desc: Kalam Wahyu is a special segment under Muslim World featuring a compilation of Quran recitations from the 2024 International Quran Recitation and Memorisation Assembly. The programme showcases beautiful and melodic recitations by participants from Bosnia Herzegovina, Kazakhstan, Canada and India reflecting the diversity and unity of the Muslim world through the art of Quranic recitation.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - SYAHADAH (UZBEKISTAN)
programme.desc: The Syahadah documentary series produced by RTM frequently features travel episodes highlighting the unique aspects and Islamic heritage of Uzbekistan. Key highlights previously broadcasted include stories of master carvers, Malaysia-Uzbekistan cultural ties, and journeys through historic locations such as Tashkent and Fergana.

programme.title: MUSLIM WORLD - KALAM WAHYU (HAFAZAN)
programme.desc: Kalam Wahyu is a special segment under Muslim World featuring a compilation of Quran memorisation recitations from the 2024 International Quran Recitation and Memorisation Assembly. The programme highlights participants from Ireland, Liberia, Mauritania and Somalia as they demonstrate their mastery and memorisation of the Holy Quran through specially tested recitation sessions.

programme.title: LIVE - WORLD TODAY
programme.desc: A comprehensive news bulletin beginning with the latest developments from Malaysia, followed by key stories from around the globe. The program concludes with a concise roundup of international sports highlights.

programme.title: Global - World Around Us
programme.desc: This episode (76), present various cultural traditions, agricultural shifts, and economic impacts around the globe, starting with the deep cultural importance of traditional Afghan flatbread (naan) as a staple of hospitality and daily life, alongside France's globally renowned cheese industry, which blends ancestral production methods with modern certification systems to protect its vital economic and heritage status. It also showcases Malaysia's tourism appeal through recurring promotional segments emphasizing its rich heritage and natural beauty. On the economic front, the video examines how the FIFA World Cup drives global commerce, particularly through Chinese manufacturers rapidly scaling the production of Lionel Messi plush toys to monetize high fan engagement. Additionally, it covers the strategic shift in northwest Syria's Idlib province toward low-water, high-value saffron cultivation to revive the war-torn economy, and concludes with the major resurgence of indigenous, nutrient-rich foods in Zimbabwe, where cities like Bulawayo are seeing an increase in traditional restaurants helping to promote healthier lifestyles and preserve national identity.

programme.title: GLOBAL PERSPECTIVE : MALAYSIA'S REGIONAL DIPLOMATIC EFFORTS
programme.desc: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Datuk Seri Anwar Ibrahim, Malaysia has prioritized an \"ASEAN First\" foreign policy centered on deepening diplomatic ties, honest communication, and mutual respect with its neighbors to bolster economic and regional stability. This cooperative framework is materialized through major high-value cross-border projects with Singapore, such as the Johor-Singapore Special Economic Zone (JSSEZ) and the Rapid Transit System (RTS) Link, which aim to enhance digital economy integrations, secure sustainable skilled employment, and improve labor mobility. Furthermore, during its 2025 ASEAN Chairmanship focused on inclusivity and sustainability, Malaysia expanded the regional architecture by admitting Timor-Leste, charting the long-term \"ASEAN 2045\" strategic vision, and demonstrating its diplomatic efficacy by facilitating a swift 24-hour ceasefire between Cambodia and Thailand. Ultimately, these parallel security and geoeconomic strategies—such as releasing a historical communique regarding Palestine/Gaza and maintaining stable dialogue over the South China Sea—reinforce ASEAN centrality while driving Malaysia forward to attract major global investments and position Southeast Asia as a resilient, high-value global economic hub.

The programme highlights their entrepreneurial spirit, creativity, and the vital role of women in driving economic growth across the ASEAN region.
